headline: Baker Hughes (BKR) Secures LNG And Gas Turbine Orders Across Key Growth Markets
summary: Baker Hughes (NasdaqGS:BKR) received a major order from Venture Global LNG for a comprehensive liquefaction solution to support an LNG expansion project in Louisiana. The company also secured an order from Dynamis Power Solutions for NovaLT™16 gas turbines, aimed at modular, high-availability power solutions for data centers and the oil & gas sector. These contracts highlight Baker Hughes’ role in large scale LNG infrastructure and the growing power demand from digital and industrial...
